Subject: Follow-up from today — model serving scope and next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier — really helpful to understand Redwood Inference's runtime offerings. As discussed, we'd like to bring a couple of folks from our backend team into a 60–90 minute technical sync (deep-dive) so we can:
- Walk through our current serving topology and constraints
- Validate latency/cost targets and feasibility for ~50 QPS burst, 512 token avg context
- Discuss private deployment options and audit/logging needs

Proposed attendees from Ava: myself, Raj Patel (platform lead), and Grace Wu (SRE). I attached a quick architecture snapshot (ava_prod_arch.png) and our SLO requirements (SLO_requirements.pdf) to give context.

We are US-west based. Suggested windows next week (PDT):
- Tue Apr 6, 9:30–11:00
- Wed Apr 7, 13:00–14:30
- Thu Apr 8, 8:00–9:30

If none of those work, happy to share a Doodle. Our ask for the session: have an infra/serving engineer + an MLOps person from Redwood join (specifics: latency profile Q&A, KV cache behavior, quantization tradeoffs, and any guardrails for private deployments).

Best,
Emma
Emma Lawson
Head of Platform
Ava Solutions

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Hi Emma — glad it was useful. Looping in Sergio (serving/runtime) and Ben (MLOps) here so they can scope the agenda.

All three time slots look workable from our side except Thu 8:00 PDT is tight for the ML infra team. Quick proposal:
- Primary: Tue Apr 6, 09:30–10:45 PDT (75 min)
- Backup: Wed Apr 7, 13:00–14:30 PDT (90 min)

Draft agenda (we can tweak):
1) 10 min — 15-minute intros and goals
2) 20–25 min — Ava runs through current serving topology and SLOs (you/Grace/Raj)
3) 20 min — Redwood presents recommended deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and cost/latency tradeoffs
4) 15–20 min — Live demo: a short run against a pinned model variant showing latency/kv cache behavior (Sergio)
5) 10–15 min — Q&A, next steps, action items (rollout plan, POC scope)

Sergio — can you confirm who from infra will drive the demo? Ben — shoud we include a one-page pre-read about batching and quantization? I can attach our short serving overview.

If that primary slot works, I'll send a calendar invite with a brief pre-read link. Also: any specific compliance docs you want before the call? We can pull SOC2 snippets if needed.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
